title: `plugins/bun.sh` fails whenever the run's cwd
result: `bun pm cache` exits 1 with `error: No package.json was found for directory ...` (full run 2026-09-12, the only failed plugin of 27). The plugin now falls back to `${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}/install/cache` with a warning.
evidence: commit 20a464f; verified from `$HOME` on the mini, where the scheduled run had failed.
